name: Baked Tofu Manchurian
ingredients: 250 g extra-firm tofu, pressed and cubed
1 tbsp each minced ginger and garlic
1 tsp cornflour mixed with ¼ cup water
steps: Toss the tofu with 1 tbsp cornflour and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Heat the oil and fry ginger and garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the capsicum and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, chilli sauce, vinegar and the cornflour slurry; simmer 1 minute until glossy.
Toss in the baked tofu and spring onions and serve immediately.
note: Baking replaces the deep-fry step of the classic.
